root_causes: golden_triangle_orchestrator.consume_and_dispatch trusts packet['packet_sha256'] and compares only that claimed value to durable pending_packet_sha256; it does not recompute the digest from packet content. A mutated packet retaining the old claimed hash can therefore pass this guard.

consume_and_dispatch changes current_role/next_role but does not persist or return the exact next pending packet path/hash. The current candidate therefore does not itself prove restart recovery of the next handoff from durable state.
